versions.changelog:
- The storage path for all vibe data has changed from kyp/vibes/ to mind/vibes/.
- All references, file paths, and configuration locations have been updated accordingly (e.g., vibesconfig.yml now lives in mind/vibes/).
- No functional or behavioral changes beyond this folder structure migration.

Major update: Vibes now tracks music, podcasts, shows, films, and YouTube channels that shape your thinking, instead of social coding status.

- Stores favorites and notes in Markdown files, organized by type (albums, podcasts, shows, films, YouTube) in a vibes/ directory.
- Structured fields capture creator, status (e.g. listening, finished), tags, and personal notes for each vibe.
- Supports searching and surfacing past favorites or recommendations based on themes, tags, and keywords.
- Allows marking items as shared with others, and integrates with Peeps when available.
- Includes guidance on capturing must-watch YouTube videos and reflecting on finished items.
- Provides detailed instructions for logging, searching, and analyzing your unique taste profile.
